slides.lectureTitle: Demonstration on KUKA KR5 Industrial Robot
slides.title: Color-Based Object Detection

visualInspection.notes: Classical OpenCV colour detection explicitly avoids deep learning/trained models. HSV thresholds: cyan hue 87–128, purple 130–155, magenta 155–180, saturation/value at least 60. Inclusive hue 155 overlaps; ordinary 8-bit OpenCV hue is 0–179, so 180 can be an upper bound but is not an encoded pixel. Pipeline includes Gaussian blur, thresholding, opening/closing and contour-area gate 800–60000 pixels; implementation details are not supplied. Demonstration hardware validation mentions cyan/magenta. Footer 23. Actual 1800×1013 pixels inspected alongside text.
